mapper.insert: WITH , , win_agg AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_count FROM public.rta_match_participant u WHERE u.season_id = #{seasonId} AND u.ladder_score > 0 AND u.wizard_id IN (SELECT pp.wizard_id FROM pool_500 pp) GROUP BY u.wizard_id ), pool_ranked_dedup_wizard AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.wizard_id) p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.country, p.channel_uid, p.max_score, p.rating_id, p.rank_position FROM pool_ranked p ORDER BY p.wizard_id, p.rank_position ASC, p.wizard_name NULLS LAST ), pool_ranked_final AS ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d.rank_position ASC, d.wizard_id ASC) AS rank_position, d.wizard_id, d.wizard_name, d.country, d.channel_uid, d.max_score, d.rating_id FROM pool_ranked_dedup_wizard d LIMIT 500 ) INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_ranking_snap ( season_id, rank_position, wizard_id, wizard_name, country, channel_uid, score, rating_id, max_season_score, match_count, win_count, computed_at ) SELECT #{seasonId}, p.rank_position, p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.country, p.channel_uid, p.max_score AS score, p.rating_id, p.max_score::int AS max_season_score, COALESCE(wa.match_count, 0)::bigint AS match_count, COALESCE(wa.win_count, 0)::bigint AS win_count, now() FROM pool_ranked_final p LEFT JOIN win_agg wa ON wa.wizard_id = p.wizard_id ORDER BY p.rank_position

WITH pick AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (mp.wizard_id) mp.wizard_id, mp.wizard_name, mp.country_code AS country, mp.channel_uid FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.wizard_id <> '' ORDER BY mp.wizard_id, mp.ladder_score DESC NULLS LAST, mp.replay_id DESC ) INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_search_snap (wizard_id, wizard_name, country, channel_uid) SELECT p.wizard_id, p.wizard_name, p.country, p.channel_uid FROM pick p ON CONFLICT (wizard_id) DO UPDATE SET wizard_name = EXCLUDED.wizard_name, country = EXCLUDED.country, channel_uid = EXCLUDED.channel_uid WHERE public.rta_agg_summoner_search_snap.wizard_name IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.wizard_name OR public.rta_agg_summoner_search_snap.country IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.country OR public.rta_agg_summoner_search_snap.channel_uid IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.channel_uid

SELECT season_id AS "seasonId", season_code AS "seasonCode", season_no AS "seasonNo", league_type AS "leagueType", season_name AS "seasonName", start_at AS "startAt", end_at AS "endAt", is_active AS "isActive", sort_order AS "sortOrder", to_char((start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startYmdKst", to_char(((end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "lastInclusiveYmdKst", to_char((end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endExclusiveYmdKst" FROM rta_season ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC, season_code ASC
SELECT season_id AS "seasonId", start_at AS "startAt", end_at AS "endAt", season_code AS "seasonCode" FROM rta_season WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE( ( SELECT season_id FROM rta_season WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY sort_order ASC, season_no DESC LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT season_id FROM rta_season ORDER BY season_no DESC, season_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) )

SELECT rg.rating_id AS "ratingId", rg.grade_name AS "gradeName", rg.grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", rg.icon_url AS "iconUrl", rg.tier_sort AS "tierSort", rgs.min_win_points AS "minWinPoints", rgs.rank_rule AS "rankRule" FROM public.rta_rating_grade rg LEFT JOIN public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs ON rgs.rating_id = rg.rating_id AND rgs.season_id = #{seasonId} WHERE rg.grade_slot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, rg.rating_id

WITH mx AS ( SELECT MAX(s.snapshot_at) AS ts FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} ) SELECT s.snapshot_at AS "snapshotAt", s.rating_id AS "ratingId", rg.grade_name AS "gradeName", rg.grade_abbr AS "gradeAbbr", s.cutoff_score AS "cutoffScore" FROM public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.rating_id = s.rating_id INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs ON rgs.rating_id = s.rating_id AND rgs.season_id = #{seasonId} CROSS JOIN mx WHERE s.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mx.ts IS NOT NULL AND s.snapshot_at = mx.ts AND rgs.min_win_points IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rg.tier_sort NULLS LAST, s.rating_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_rank_cutoff_anchor_snap (snapshot_at, sort_order, anchor_key, grade_slot, cutoff_score) WITH , rank_window AS ( SELECT (MAX(r.date_add)::date - INTERVAL '120 days')::date AS min_date FROM rta_match_in_season r ), rta_match_in_window AS ( SELECT r.rid, r.date_add, r.winner_wizard_id, r.battle_type FROM rta_match_in_season r INNER JOIN rank_window w ON r.date_add::date >= w.min_date ), anchors AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES (1, '3h', INTERVAL '3 hours'), (2, '6h', INTERVAL '6 hours'), (3, '12h', INTERVAL '12 hours'), (4, '3d', INTERVAL '3 days'), (5, '7d', INTERVAL '7 days') ) AS v(sort_order, anchor_key, iv) ), base AS ( SELECT r.date_add, u.ladder_score AS score_val, ( CASE WHEN u.rating_id >= 5000 THEN 60 WHEN u.rating_id >= 4000 THEN 50 WHEN u.rating_id >= 3500 THEN 40 WHEN u.rating_id >= 3000 THEN 30 WHEN u.rating_id >= 2000 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN (u.rating_id % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (u.rating_id % 10) ELSE 2 END ) AS tier_sort_order, ( CASE WHEN u.rating_id >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN u.rating_id >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN u.rating_id >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN u.rating_id >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN u.rating_id >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (u.rating_id % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (u.rating_id % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS grade_slot FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_window r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.rating_id >= 1000 AND u.ladder_score > 0 ), tiers AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('G3', 53), ('G2', 52), ('G1', 51), ('P3', 43), ('P2', 42) ) AS tv(grade_slot, tier_sort_order) ), , lower_bound AS ( SELECT a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.grade_slot, MAX(b.score_val)::bigint AS lower_max_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN base b ON b.tier_sort_order < t.tier_sort_order AND b.date_add >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - a.iv AND b.date_add <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, a.iv, t.grade_slot, t.tier_sort_order ) SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, a.sort_order, a.anchor_key, t.grade_slot, GREATEST( COALESCE(tof.min_pts, 0)::bigint, COALESCE(lb.lower_max_score + 1, 0)::bigint ) AS cutoff_score FROM anchors a CROSS JOIN tiers t LEFT JOIN tier_official tof ON tof.grade_slot = t.grade_slot LEFT JOIN lower_bound lb ON lb.sort_order = a.sort_order AND lb.anchor_key = a.anchor_key AND lb.grade_slot = t.grade_slot

INSERT INTO public.rta_snapshot_rank_cut (season_id, snapshot_at, rating_id, cutoff_score) SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.season_id, rg.rating_id) s.season_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rg.rating_id, COALESCE(( SELECT MIN(u.ladder_score) FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON m.replay_id = u.replay_id WHERE u.season_id = s.season_id AND m.season_id = s.season_id AND m.played_at >= s.start_at AND m.played_at < s.end_at AND u.rating_id = rg.rating_id AND u.ladder_score > 0 ), rgs.min_win_points, 0)::bigint FROM public.rta_season s INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade_season rgs ON rgs.season_id = s.season_id AND rgs.min_win_points IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN public.rta_rating_grade rg ON rg.rating_id = rgs.rating_id AND rg.grade_slot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.season_id, rg.rating_id

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_season_rating_match_total (season_id, rating_id, total_matches, computed_at) SELECT m.season_id, p.rating_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.replay_id)::bigint AS total_matches, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM public.rta_match_participant p INNER JOIN public.rta_match m ON m.replay_id = p.replay_id WHERE p.rating_id IS NOT NULL AND p.rating_id > 0 GROUP BY m.season_id, p.rating_id ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id) DO UPDATE SET total_matches = EXCLUDED.total_matches, computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at

WITH raw AS ( SELECT c.opponent_monster_id::text AS opponent_combo_key, 1::smallint AS opponent_combo_size, SUM(c.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(c.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_counter_solo c WHERE c.season_id = #{seasonId} AND c.subject_monster_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY c.opponent_monster_id UNION ALL SELECT c.opponent_monster_id AS opponent_combo_key, 2::smallint AS opponent_combo_size, SUM(c.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(c.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_counter_duo c WHERE c.season_id = #{seasonId} AND c.subject_monster_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY c.opponent_monster_id UNION ALL SELECT c.opponent_monster_id AS opponent_combo_key, 3::smallint AS opponent_combo_size, SUM(c.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(c.lose_cnt)::bigint AS lose_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_counter_trio c WHERE c.season_id = #{seasonId} AND c.subject_monster_id = #{monsterId} GROUP BY c.opponent_monster_id ) SELECT x.opponent_combo_key AS "opponentComboKey", x.opponent_combo_size AS "opponentComboSize", x.win_cnt AS "winCnt", x.lose_cnt AS "loseCnt", CASE WHEN (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt) > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * x.win_cnt::numeric / (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt)::numeric, 2) ELSE NULL END AS "winRate", ( SELECT string_agg(m.kr_name, ' + ' ORDER BY z.ord) FROM unnest(string_to_array(x.opponent_combo_key, ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS z(id, ord) LEFT JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = NULLIF(z.id, '') ) AS "opponentLabel" FROM raw x ORDER BY (x.win_cnt + x.lose_cnt) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 40
SELECT DISTINCT season_id FROM public.rta_match_participant WHERE season_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY season_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_pick_turn ( season_id, rating_id, monster_id, pick_turn, pick_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, lose_cnt, ban_cnt, updated_at ) SELECT mp.season_id, mp.rating_id, up.unit_master_id AS monster_id, up.pick_slot_no AS pick_turn, COUNT(*)::bigint AS pick_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT up.is_banned AND mp.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT up.is_banned AND NOT mp.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS lose_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS ban_cnt, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = up.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = up.wizard_id WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.rating_id IS NOT NULL AND mp.rating_id > 0 GROUP BY mp.season_id, mp.rating_id, up.unit_master_id, up.pick_slot_no ON CONFLICT (season_id, rating_id, monster_id, pick_turn) DO UPDATE SET pick_cnt = EXCLUDED.pick_cnt, match_cnt = EXCLUDED.match_cnt, win_cnt = EXCLUDED.win_cnt, lose_cnt = EXCLUDED.lose_cnt, ban_cnt = EXCLUDED.ban_cnt, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap ( season_id, wizard_id, match_cnt, non_ban_pick_cnt, ban_event_cnt, computed_at ) WITH part AS ( SELECT mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.replay_id)::bigint AS match_cnt FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.rating_id IS NOT NULL AND mp.rating_id > 0 GROUP BY mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id ), picks AS ( SELECT mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS non_ban_pick_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN up.is_banned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS ban_event_cnt FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant mp ON mp.replay_id = up.replay_id AND mp.wizard_id = up.wizard_id WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.rating_id IS NOT NULL AND mp.rating_id > 0 GROUP BY mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id ) SELECT p.season_id, p.wizard_id, p.match_cnt, COALESCE(pk.non_ban_pick_cnt, 0::bigint), COALESCE(pk.ban_event_cnt, 0::bigint), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM part p LEFT JOIN picks pk ON pk.season_id = p.season_id AND pk.wizard_id = p.wizard_id

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap ( season_id, wizard_id, unit_master_id, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, win_cnt, lose_cnt, first_pick_cnt, owned_copy_count, computed_at ) WITH pnorm AS ( SELECT mp.replay_id, mp.season_id, mp.wizard_id, mp.is_winner FROM public.rta_match_participant mp WHERE mp.season_id = #{seasonId} AND mp.rating_id IS NOT NULL AND mp.rating_id > 0 AND mp.replay_id = ANY(#{rids}) ), upnorm AS ( SELECT up.replay_id, up.wizard_id, up.unit_master_id, up.is_banned, up.pick_slot_no FROM public.rta_match_unit_pick up WHERE up.replay_id = ANY(#{rids}) ), min_non_ban AS ( SELECT n.replay_id, n.wizard_id, MIN(n.pick_slot_no)::int2 AS min_slot FROM upnorm n WHERE NOT n.is_banned GROUP BY n.replay_id, n.wizard_id ), agg AS ( SELECT p.season_id, p.wizard_id, u.unit_master_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned)::bigint AS pick_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.is_banned)::bigint AS ban_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND p.is_winner)::bigint AS win_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND NOT p.is_winner)::bigint AS lose_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT u.is_banned AND m.min_slot IS NOT NULL AND u.pick_slot_no = m.min_slot )::bigint AS first_pick_cnt FROM pnorm p INNER JOIN upnorm u ON u.replay_id = p.replay_id AND u.wizard_id = p.wizard_id LEFT JOIN min_non_ban m ON m.replay_id = u.replay_id AND m.wizard_id = u.wizard_id GROUP BY p.season_id, p.wizard_id, u.unit_master_id ) SELECT a.season_id, a.wizard_id, a.unit_master_id, a.pick_cnt, a.ban_cnt, a.win_cnt, a.lose_cnt, a.first_pick_cnt, COALESCE(o.copy_count, 0)::int, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM agg a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wizard_id, master_id, MAX(copy_count)::int AS copy_count FROM public.user_monster_owned_agg GROUP BY wizard_id, master_id ) o ON o.wizard_id = a.wizard_id AND o.master_id = a.unit_master_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_season_fight_snap
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM public.rta_agg_summoner_monster_snap
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap ( season_id, stat_kind, rank_position, combo_unit_key, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, computed_at ) SELECT t.season_id, 'S', t.rn, t.combo_unit_key, t.pick_cnt, t.ban_cnt, t.match_cnt, t.win_cnt, now() FROM ( SELECT g.season_id, g.combo_unit_key, g.pick_cnt, g.ban_cnt, g.match_cnt, g.win_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY g.pick_cnt DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key, SUM(sg.pick_cnt)::bigint AS pick_cnt, SUM(COALESCE(sg.ban_cnt, 0))::bigint AS ban_cnt, SUM(sg.match_cnt)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(sg.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_solo sg INNER JOIN public.monster m ON m.monster_id = sg.combo_unit_key WHERE sg.season_id = #{seasonId} AND sg.rating_id > 0 AND m.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key HAVING SUM(sg.pick_cnt) >= #{minPickCount} ) g ) t WHERE t.rn <= 100

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap ( season_id, stat_kind, rank_position, combo_unit_key, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, computed_at ) SELECT t.season_id, 'D', t.rn, t.combo_unit_key, NULL, NULL, t.match_cnt, t.win_cnt, now() FROM ( SELECT g.season_id, g.combo_unit_key, g.match_cnt, g.win_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY g.match_cnt DESC, (g.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(g.match_cnt, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key, SUM(sg.match_cnt)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(sg.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_duo sg INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) WHERE sg.season_id = #{seasonId} AND sg.rating_id > 0 AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key HAVING SUM(sg.match_cnt) >= #{minPickCount} ) g ) t WHERE t.rn <= 100

INSERT INTO public.rta_agg_monster_stats_tier_top_snap ( season_id, stat_kind, rank_position, combo_unit_key, pick_cnt, ban_cnt, match_cnt, win_cnt, computed_at ) SELECT t.season_id, 'T', t.rn, t.combo_unit_key, NULL, NULL, t.match_cnt, t.win_cnt, now() FROM ( SELECT g.season_id, g.combo_unit_key, g.match_cnt, g.win_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY g.match_cnt DESC, (g.win_cnt::numeric / NULLIF(g.match_cnt, 0)) DESC NULLS LAST ) AS rn FROM ( SELECT sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key, SUM(sg.match_cnt)::bigint AS match_cnt, SUM(sg.win_cnt)::bigint AS win_cnt FROM public.rta_agg_synergy_trio sg INNER JOIN public.monster m1 ON m1.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 1) INNER JOIN public.monster m2 ON m2.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 2) INNER JOIN public.monster m3 ON m3.monster_id = split_part(sg.combo_unit_key, ',', 3) WHERE sg.season_id = #{seasonId} AND sg.rating_id > 0 AND m1.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m2.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND m3.kr_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sg.season_id, sg.combo_unit_key HAVING SUM(sg.match_cnt) >= #{minPickCount} ) g ) t WHERE t.rn <= 100
